newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal lowers budget deficit estimate - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal lowers budget deficit estimate - paper.

text.p: The government has told the European Commission that Portugal's 1995 budget deficit was 4.9 percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP), lower than the previous estimate, Lisbon daily Diario Economico said, quoting an official source.
No government comment was immediately available on the report.
The government had previously estimated the 1995 budget deficit at 5.2 percent of GDP.
The latest estimate was delivered to the Commission at the end of August as part of a regular review of member states' compliance with targets for Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).

"(Finance Minister Antonio) Sousa Franco has a large margin for manoeuvre to meet the target set for this year, as he will not have to make an extraordinary effort to obtain a budget deficit of 4.2 percent of GDP," Diario Economico said.
